gaps.explanation: The bond proceeds are already in detail[]: Road Fund budgetary comparison (p11) 'Bond proceeds' 12,685,000 = statement debt_proceeds 12,685,000 (Road Fund column, p6). The schedule total 13,046,131 also counts the next detail line of the same schedule, 'Premium on bonds' 361,131 (p11), which the statement prints as its own other-financing row 'Premium on bond' 361,131 (p6) and the JSON carries in other_financing (394,525 = Sale of surplus 33,394 + Premium on bond 361,131), not in debt_proceeds. 12,685,000 + 361,131 = 13,046,131; gap -361,131 = the premium. Nothing missing or duplicated; no fix. Other other-financing rows on p6: Sale of surplus General 29,154 + Road 4,240 = 33,394 is already inside the budget schedules' 'Local' receipts (pass 1), so adding it would double count; transfer lines are all labelled the right way round.
